name: tauri-plugin-passkey-api
author: Don Kackman
description: Tauri plugin for WebAuthn / passkey (FIDO2) authentication on macOS/iOS, Windows, Android, and Linux.

scripts.test: pnpm test:js && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:swift:macos && pnpm test:android
scripts.test:swift:ios: ./scripts/materialize-tauri-ios.sh && cd ios && xcodebuild test -scheme tauri-plugin-passkey -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17'
scripts.test:android: cd android && (./gradlew test || gradle test || echo 'Note: Gradle wrapper not found. Install Gradle or run from Android Studio')
scripts.test:android:instrumented: cd android && (./gradlew connectedAndroidTest || gradle connectedAndroidTest || echo 'Note: Gradle wrapper not found. Install Gradle or run from Android Studio')
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cargo fmt && (swiftformat ios/ macos/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Note: swiftformat not installed. Install with: brew install swiftformat') && pnpm format:kotlin
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cargo fmt --check && (swiftformat --lint ios/ macos/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Note: swiftformat not installed') && pnpm format:check:kotlin
scripts.format:swift: swiftformat ios/ macos/ || echo 'Note: swiftformat not installed. Install with: brew install swiftformat'
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && (swiftlint lint --no-cache || { command -v swiftlint >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 1; echo 'Note: swiftlint not installed. Install with: brew install swiftlint'; }) && pnpm lint:kotlin
scripts.lint:swift: swiftlint lint --no-cache || { command -v swiftlint >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 1; echo 'Note: swiftlint not installed. Install with: brew install swiftlint'; }
